europe_now.title: US Selects Poland for Patriot Missile Facility
europe_now.summary: The United States has chosen Poland to host a new service facility dedicated to Patriot missiles. This development marks a significant strengthening of regional defense infrastructure and bilateral military ties.

europe_now.title: EU Plans Critical Minerals Investment in Australia
europe_now.summary: The European Union is planning a massive investment in Australian critical minerals to reduce its heavy reliance on China. The initiative aims to secure vital supply chains and enhance the bloc's long-term economic resilience.

sources.headline: EU plans massive investment in Australia’s critical minerals to cut dependence on China
